headline.en: See when a harness rewrites conversation history.
headline.zh: 看见调用框架何时重写会话历史。

sub.en: CachePin tracks message prefixes between requests and optionally rewrites mutated histories into append-only extensions of its canonical history.
sub.zh: CachePin 跟踪请求之间的消息前缀，并可将变化历史改写为规范历史的追加扩展。

body.en: The common-prefix index points to the first changed message.
body.zh: 公共前缀索引指向首条变化消息。

body.en: Canonical history and appended suffix are explicit.
body.zh: 规范历史与追加后缀均明确可见。

body.en: The proxy sits between a harness and its compatible endpoint.
body.zh: 代理位于调用框架与兼容端点之间。

note.zh: 比较一条助手回答发生变化的两份明确历史，再打印生产协调器实际保留与追加的内容。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/cachepin.git
cd cachepin
go build ./cmd/cachepin

limitations.en: Prefix percentages and reprocessed-token values are message-based observations and estimates, not direct KV cache telemetry.
limitations.zh: 前缀百分比与重新处理 token 值是基于消息的观察和估计，不是直接 KV 缓存遥测。

limitations.en: --pin changes request semantics: an edited or removed earlier message can remain in canonical history, and appended content can increase context length.
limitations.zh: --pin 会改变请求语义：被编辑或删除的旧消息可能仍保留在规范历史，追加内容也会增加上下文长度。

limitations.en: The demo only reconciles message arrays; it does not establish server cache reuse or throughput savings.
limitations.zh: 示例仅协调消息数组，不证明服务器缓存复用或吞吐收益。

body.en: A reordered or rewritten early message changes the input prefix even when most of the conversation looks unchanged. Message-level tracking makes that mutation visible before you interpret cache behavior.
body.zh: 早期消息重排或改写会改变输入前缀，即使大部分会话看起来没有变化。消息级跟踪让你在解释缓存行为之前看到这些变化。

body.en: The proxy parses chat requests while preserving unknown fields. Session tracking hashes messages and finds the longest common prefix. In pin mode, reconciliation preserves the entire canonical history and appends the incoming suffix from the mutation boundary.
body.zh: 代理解析聊天请求并保留未知字段；会话跟踪对消息计算哈希并寻找最长公共前缀。pin 模式保留全部规范历史，再从变化边界追加传入后缀。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Configure the upstream server and point the harness base URL at CachePin’s listener. Pin mode is opt-in. Use explicit session identity when the harness supports it and inspect the request semantics before enabling rewrites.
body.zh: 配置上游服务器，再把调用框架 base URL 指向 CachePin 监听地址。pin 模式需要显式开启。框架支持时应使用明确会话标识，并在启用改写前检查请求语义。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/cachepin --upstream http://localhost:8080
# Enable only after reviewing append-only semantics:
go run ./cmd/cachepin --upstream http://localhost:8080 --pin

changelog.zh: v0.11.0：SIGINT/SIGTERM 现在走优雅停机——进行中的请求（含 SSE 流式生成）有 30 秒排空窗口完成，而不是随进程被掐断。
changelog.en: v0.11.0: SIGINT/SIGTERM now drain gracefully — in-flight requests (including streaming generations) get a 30-second window to finish instead of being cut with the process.

zh: 版本面同源锁步：web/site.json 的 content_version 此前停在 v0.7.0，落后于发版标签两个 minor（v0.8.0 / v0.9.0 发版都没刷新它），现与 VERSION / CHANGELOG / CLI --version 对齐为同一来源，并加锁步测试守卫——发版时任一面漂移即 CI 失败。
补回缺失的 CLI --version：goreleaser 此前用 -X main.version 注入一个不存在的符号（Go 静默忽略 -X），现以 //go:embed VERSION 为单一真源，二进制的 --version 真正可用。
en: Version surfaces in lockstep: web/site.json content_version had been frozen at v0.7.0 — two minors behind the shipped tag (neither the v0.8.0 nor v0.9.0 release refreshed it). It now matches VERSION / CHANGELOG / the CLI --version as one source, guarded by a lockstep test that fails CI on any drift.

Restored the missing CLI --version: goreleaser had injected -X main.version into a symbol that did not exist (Go silently ignores -X on an absent symbol); the version now comes from a single //go:embed VERSION source, and the binary's --version actually works.

zh: --pin 现在扛得住 system prompt 的重渲染——session-id 改为只取首条 user 消息，harness 重渲染系统提示（压缩上下文、重排工具 schema）不再 fork 会话、不再报「100% 保留 · 0 重处理」的静默绿灯，而是被当作 msg[0] 的内容发散捕获，--pin 也拿到真实前序 canonical 可供对齐。
代理做了 slowloris 加固——显式 http.Server 设置 ReadHeaderTimeout/IdleTimeout，慢连接或崩溃后悬挂的连接不再长期占用服务端 goroutine；WriteTimeout 保持为 0，SSE /chat/completions 流不会被中途掐断。
en: --pin now survives system-prompt re-renders — session-id is derived from the first user message only, so a harness re-rendering the system prompt (context compaction, a tool-schema reorder) no longer forks the session and reports a silent-green '100% preserved | 0 reprocessed' while the upstream reprocesses everything; it is now caught as a content divergence at msg[0], and --pin gets a real prior canonical to reconcile against.

The proxy is slowloris-hardened — an explicit http.Server sets ReadHeaderTimeout/IdleTimeout so a slow or dangling client can no longer hold a server goroutine forever; WriteTimeout stays at zero so SSE /chat/completions streams are not cut off mid-token.

zh: 空闲会话现在每一轮都过期——即便关掉会话数上限（--max-sessions 0 --idle-ttl 10m），长跑部署的内存也有界；过期不再只在「新会话到来」时才扫一次。
同一会话被并发投递的多轮请求不再悄悄丢一轮——读历史、重排、写回合成一个不可插队的步骤，并行工具调用和批量补全下每一轮都留在钉住的历史里。
en: Idle sessions now expire on every turn — memory stays bounded on long-uptime deployments even with the session cap off (--max-sessions 0 --idle-ttl 10m); the sweep no longer fires only when a brand-new session arrives.

Concurrent same-session turns no longer get silently dropped — read-history, reconcile, and write-back now run as one uninterruptible step, so every turn stays in the pinned history under parallel tool calls and batched completions.
